attic.enter.first.speaker: hero
attic.enter.first.text: How did I get up here?

attic.window.look.speaker: hero
attic.window.look.text: A dusty window. Too small to climb through.

attic.chest.look.speaker: hero
attic.chest.look.text: An old chest with a cheap padlock.

attic.chest.item.crowbar.speaker: hero
attic.chest.item.crowbar.text: One good pull... and it's open.

attic.crowbar.look.speaker: hero
attic.crowbar.look.text: A crowbar, leaning on the wall.

attic.key.look.speaker: hero
attic.key.look.text: A key, at the bottom of the chest.
